html: † בֵּית fem. of בַּיִן, בֵּין (NöM 194 f.; Syriac ܒܶܝܬ often, PS 470) prep. between Ez 41:9b (to be joined with v 10; see RVm), unless indeed a mere error for בֵּין (which Ez often uses); also Pr 8:2 according to 𝔊 (ἀνὰ μέσον) 𝔗 𝔙 Hi Ew§ 217 g; and Jb 8:17 according to 𝔊 Ew Di1 (Di2 undecided).
